posts.coverText: First one to dodge this question does the dishes

slideText.text: What was your honest first impression of me?
What's a silly nickname you secretly want to call me?
What's the cutest habit of mine that you secretly love?
What's the one thing you've never told me because it might hurt me?
Be honest: what is the most exhausting part of being in a relationship with me?

posts.coverText: Marriage life after this question 🤯

slideText.text: What aspect of our future together worries you the most?
What's the biggest fear you have about our future together?
What's the one thing about our future together that scares you the most?
If you could grant us one wish for our future together, what would it be?
If you were married to another woman and you met me, would you cheat on her with me?

posts.coverText: The moment we both blushed

slideText.text: What turns you on, my hair tied or untied?
What's the weirdest thing you find attractive about me?
What's the most unexpected thing about me that turns you on?
If someone flirted with you while we were fighting - would you tell me?
When you first met me, what physical feature of mine turned you on the most?

posts.coverText: Pre-divorce question round. Here we go.

slideText.text: What part of my personality annoys you the most?
Have you ever wanted to leave me for a better-looking guy?
If you could leave me a note to read in 10 years, what would it say?
If someone else offered you the 'perfect' relationship, would you leave me?
If your mom told you to break up with me tomorrow, would you listen to her or fight for us?

posts.coverText: Red flags hiding in his answers 🚩

slideText.text: What's my funniest red flag?
Have you ever compared me to your ex?
Have you ever lied to me to protect my feelings? What was it about?
Have you ever wondered if an ex was better suited for you than I am?
Have you ever felt jealous of my relationship with someone else? Who and why?

posts.coverText: POV: she says "I know everything about you"

slideText.text: What's my biggest green flag?
What do you think is my biggest insecurity?
What would you say is my biggest turn-on is?
What has been my biggest impact on your life?
If someone asked you to name my biggest red flag, what is it?

posts.coverText: Take me back to our first conversation

slideText.text: Do you ever replay our first kiss in your head?
When was the first time you thought "she's the one"?
Who do you think was more nervous on our first date?
If we met today for the first time, how would you try to get my attention?
What's a detail about the first time we met that you think you'll remember forever?

posts.coverText: Answer fast. No thinking allowed.

slideText.text: Am I the drama or the peacekeeper?
Did you fall for me or did I just grow on you?
What's your favorite word or phrase I say often?
Do you feel like we're growing together or apart?
What's my main skill: chaos, noise, or confusion?

posts.coverText: Things I wish we'd asked sooner

slideText.text: What is your love language?
What's something you need from me that I don't give?
What's something I do that secretly makes you feel loved?
Was I the type of person you expected to fall in love with?
What do you need from me that you're not currently getting?

posts.coverText: Rating my husband's answers out of 10

slideText.text: Rate my jealousy out of 10.
Rate how annoying I am out of 10.
How did you first describe me to your friends?
If you had to describe me in three words what would they be?
If your friends rated you as a boyfriend, what would they say you suck at?

posts.coverText: He did NOT see this question coming

slideText.text: If we could have a perfect day together, what would it look like?
If we had to create a couple's theme song, what would the title be?
If we weren't in a relationship, what pickup line would you use with me?
If we could start a new tradition together, what would you want it to be?
If we could start over knowing everything we know now, would you still choose me?

posts.coverText: Couples who can't answer this, worry

slideText.text: How do you know I trust you?
How do you know when I've missed you?
What makes me different from other guys?
If someone asked, "Why do you love them?" what would you say?
What makes me different from other girls you've dated/talked to in the past?

posts.coverText: Unpopular opinion: date nights are overrated

slideText.text: Would you still date me if I was a worm?
What was your favorite date we've ever had? Why?
What did you tell your friends after our first date?
What did you want to do on our first date but didn't?
Which of our dates would you love to relive, and why?

posts.coverText: Asked him this at 2 AM…

slideText.text: What is your biggest fear in life?
How do you feel when I cry in front of you?
What do you fear I'll never understand about you?
If you could ask me anything with no fear, what would it be?
Are you with me because you truly love me, or just because you're scared of starting over?

posts.coverText: 3 years together and I never knew this

slideText.text: What's a secret dream you've never told anyone (even me)?
What's one childhood memory that shaped who you are today?
What's one thing you've never told me about your feelings?
What's one thing about me that you noticed but never told me?
Is there something you've never told me because you thought I'd react badly?

posts.coverText: Storytime: one question changed our relationship

slideText.text: What changed in you after we met?
What moment with me changed the way you view love?
What part of your life has changed the most since we met?
What's something I've done that changed the way you see love?
When was the specific moment you knew you wanted to be with me?

posts.coverText: Wait for his answer 👀

slideText.text: Would you still choose me if your family disliked me?
If I completely changed tomorrow, would you still choose me?
Would you still love me if I was the most beautiful woman in the world and everyone wanted me?
If I asked your best friend what you say about me when I'm not around, what would they tell me?
If I asked you to choose between gaming for a week or cuddling with me every night — what would you pick?

posts.coverText: Guess who's the jealous one

slideText.text: Who is one person you tell everything to?
If we broke up today, who is the first girl you would hit up?
If aliens forced you to delete one female contact, who is it?
If you could secretly read my texts with anyone, who would it be?
Who is the one person from your past that took you the longest to get over?

posts.coverText: Don't ask your partner this. Seriously.

slideText.text: What excites you most about getting to know me more?
What's something you wish we could experience together?
Have you kept in touch with any exes without telling me?
What does it feel like when I'm next to you vs when I'm not?
If your ex showed up right now and said she still loves you, what would you honestly feel?

posts.coverText: The question therapists say couples skip

slideText.text: What's the most hurtful thing I've said to you?
What's the hardest thing for you to forgive about me?
What's the most hurtful thing I've done without realizing it?
What is one thing I do that unintentionally hurts your feelings?
Have you ever lied to me because you thought the truth would hurt me?

posts.coverText: Green flag or red flag? You decide

slideText.text: What's something you pretend you're okay with but you're not?
If we could relive one day together, which day would you pick?
What's something I do that you act okay with, but secretly aren't?
If you could secretly read one of my conversations which one would you pick?
If you had to pick one moment that defines us as a couple, what would it be?

posts.coverText: Reading his answer out loud, sorry babe

slideText.text: What's something you miss about being single?
What do you love most about your body and why?
What do you love most about the way we are together?
What's your favorite thing about me that isn't physical?
What do you love about us that other couples don't have?

posts.coverText: Most couples fail question #3

slideText.text: What did I fix inside you without even trying?
Can you remember what I was wearing when we met?
Do you remember what you felt during our first kiss?
Remember the day we first met? How would you describe it now?
If I woke up with amnesia, what's the first thing you'd want me to remember?

posts.coverText: New trick for awkward silences unlocked 🤯

slideText.text: If you could change one of my habits, what would it be and why?
If you could plan a perfect day for us, what would it look like?
If you could have a relationship do-over, would you choose me again?
If you could relive one moment from our relationship, what would it be?
If you could give me one piece of advice to make me a better partner, what would it be?

posts.coverText: Comment your answer before he does

slideText.text: If I was a burglar, what's the dumbest thing I'd steal?
What's the most romantic thing I've done for you recently?
What's the best thing I've ever given you? (besides me, obviously)
What's the most important lesson you've learned from our relationship?
Would you rather redo your worst argument or relive your best memory together?
